per_query.question: Welche Kundengruppen bringen den meisten Nettoerlös?
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT cd.customer_type_id,
       cd.customer_desc,
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM public.customer_demographics cd
JOIN public.customer_customer_demo ccd ON ccd.customer_type_id = cd.customer_type_id
JOIN public.customers c ON c.customer_id = ccd.customer_id
JOIN public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY cd.customer_type_id, cd.customer_desc
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, cd.customer_type_id

per_query.question: Welcher Zusteller ist im Schnitt am unpünktlichsten?
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT s.shipper_id,
       s.company_name,
       AVG(CASE WHEN o.shipped_date > o.required_date THEN (o.shipped_date - o.required_date)::numeric END) AS avg_late_days,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.shipped_date > o.required_date) AS late_orders,
       COUNT(*) AS shipped_orders
FROM public.orders o
JOIN public.shippers s ON s.shipper_id = o.ship_via
WHERE o.shipped_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.required_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.shipper_id, s.company_name
ORDER BY avg_late_days DESC NULLS LAST, late_orders DESC, s.shipper_id

per_query.question: Wie läuft es monatlich mit Aufträgen und Pünktlichkeit?
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_created,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE o.shipped_date > o.required_date) AS late_orders
FROM public.orders o
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date
ORDER BY month
